verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: For TODAY, I’d only bother with Rey Cortiço after work starting around 16:30 if the cameras look decent, because the Surfline consistency isn’t great and the wind angle is pretty off for that spot. Do a quick check on Surfline and MEO Beachcam before you leave—if it doesn’t look cleaner than expected, it’s probably not worth the effort. Tide is dropping low, so you’ll really be relying on the sandbanks being lined up for those short, punchy peaks. Start with Rey Cortiço, but let the cam check decide.
